originality.rationale: Fused live retrieval on all three normalized forms in one scope_literature_search call (partial=false; serpbase/crossref ok, openalex ok with 0 hits) returned no source stating or implying any of the six L1 rationals. Closest hits are Euclidean-codomain analogues (Vallentin 2008, Cioaba et al. 2023) and object-only censuses (Foster census, Conder list) plus general L1 surveys. Full fetches confirm: Vallentin abstract is Euclidean SDP/orthogonal-polynomial lower bound for Hamming/Johnson/strongly-regular graphs (different codomain/method); Foster census site distributes sparse6/LCF tables with no distortion column; Conder 2048-list rows for the six targets give only |Aut|/type/girth/diameter/bipartiteness. Adversarial checklist (synonyms, encodings, broader theorems, databases, recomputation) completed — see decisive_checks. No prior source covers the claim even as special case or corollary.

value.rationale: TARGET route (report states claim_route TARGET; audited normally against admitted target). Six exact L1-distortion rationals for pre-fixed iconic smallest cubic-symmetric orders (10,14,16,18,20,20) with matching exact cut/dual certificates, proved symmetry-reduction quotient LP, and 4/3-maximum identification. Extends recognized Vallentin/Cioaba exact-distortion program from Euclidean (L2 SDP) to L1 cut-cone setting needed by Ribe/sparsest-cut work; supplies citable benchmark instances for L1/sparsest-cut solvers and calibrated base cases for girth/diameter-vs-distortion conjectures plus seed rows for larger Foster orders. Scope fixed by Foster/Conder census before computation, not result-defined. Eligible narrow exact invariant of motivated natural objects: objects and invariant motivated before computation, values not known or mechanically implied (logarithmic bounds near-trivial at n<=20), future researcher could need precise rationals. Not textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.

broader_coverage.evidence: Searched dominance direction: 'least distortion constants L1 embedding census cubic symmetric distance-regular graphs classification table Vallentin cut cone duality'. Top hits: Vallentin 2008 (Euclidean SDP), Cioaba et al. Euclidean analogue, Linial-Magen/Indyk general L1 theory (Bourgain O(log n), LLR cut-cone/sparsest-cut), Brouwer-Cohen-Neumaier classification (objects only). General cut-cone LP duality characterizes c1 abstractly but instantiates no values; Bourgain/LLR/Rabinovich-Raz asymptotic bounds are near-trivial at n<=20 and imply no exact matching upper bound; Vallentin/Cioaba are L2-codomain (SDP/association schemes) with different duals and state no L1 rationals.
broader_coverage.searched: Dominance query for stronger theorem / broader object class / larger parameter range / exhaustive census / established database covering the claim as special case.
broader_coverage.why_not_cover: No broader theorem implies the exact 1 vs 4/3 values: Euclidean results use different codomain and method; asymptotic log bounds cannot mechanically yield exact matching cut families; general LP duality is an enabling tool, not a publication of these six instantiations.

claim_vs_prior_implication.evidence: No retrieved source states c1=1 for Petersen/Desargues/Dodecahedron or c1=4/3 for Heawood/MK/Pappus, with or without cut/dual certificates. Dual optima (e.g. Heawood p on 28 diametral pairs giving 84/63=4/3; MK p=(0,0,0,1/96,1/48); Pappus p on 18 diametral pairs 72/54=4/3) and primal orbit families (28-cut, 16+6, 18-cut orbits; exact z=d for the three c1=1 graphs) appear nowhere in the fused set or the fetched censuses. Averaging-in-cut-cone symmetrization is a standard technique but no source publishes these values as corollary, substitution, or recomputation.
